text: I'm writing about the $640 back-dated on my account. Money's tight week to week and I can't clear it in one go. Could we agree a repayment plan — I'd suggest $40 a week on top of my regular bill until it's cleared. Please confirm in writing and I'll set it up.
reply:
Dear Ms Daly,

Thank you for your letter of 18 March about the $640 back-dated charge on your account.

I'm sorry we can't accept $40 a week, as that would take 16 weeks, which is longer than the repayment plans we can agree. Instead, I can offer a plan of 12 equal weekly instalments of $53.33, with the final instalment adjusted to $53.37 so the total comes to exactly $640.00. This would be paid on top of your regular $48 weekly bill each Wednesday.

The plan will run for 12 weeks from your first payment. Your account is currently up to date, with no overdue or due amounts.

If you're happy with this, please reply to confirm and we'll record the plan on your account. If the weekly amount is still too much, please let us know your situation and we'll look at what we can do.

Kind regards,
Northgrid Energy Customer Desk

text: Hello, thanks for coming back to me. I'll take the 12-week plan at $53.33 a week — please record it on my account. I'd have liked longer but I understand the rules. Thanks for sorting it out.
reply:
Dear Ms Daly,

Thank you for your letter of 19 March. I can confirm that a 12-week payment plan has been agreed on your account, with equal weekly instalments of $53.33. We have recorded this against your account at High Street, Wenlow.

Your regular bill remains $48 a week on Wednesdays, and your account currently shows no overdue or due-and-unpaid balance.

If you have any questions about the plan or your account, please get in touch.

Kind regards,
Northgrid Energy Customer Desk

text: Hi, it’s Alan Daly at Wenlow Bakery & Deli. I need to confirm reliable stock for Monday 30 March. Can you quote/availability for a large order of baskets and tell me earliest delivery date? I’m trying to avoid empty shelves again.

text: Hello, thank you for your note. Sorry, I should have been clearer. Please can you check current stock and confirm the earliest delivery slot for 360 baskets at $6.54 each, ideally Monday 30 March or sooner? If 360 is not possible, please tell me the largest quantity you can guarantee. I need a firm answer before the weekend because my shelves were empty last week. reply:
Dear Alan,

Thank you for your letter, and I'm sorry to hear your shelves were empty last week.

I can see on your account that the current price is $6.54 per unit, which is the price you quoted. However, I cannot see any order for Monday 30 March on your account, and there has been no delivery this week. I also cannot confirm live stock levels or guarantee a delivery slot from this desk, and I'm not able to place or change orders on your behalf.

To secure 360 baskets for Monday, or the largest quantity we can supply, please place the order through our ordering system or call the sales desk directly before the weekend. Ask for the earliest available slot and quote your account name, Wenlow Bakery & Deli, so the stock check can be done before you commit. If 360 isn't available, the team can tell you the maximum quantity we can guarantee for Monday.

Kind regards,
Sales Desk, Brook Cash & Carry

text: Hello, sorry to chase. Could you confirm by phone/return message whether the 360 units for Monday 30 March are definitely in stock and will arrive Monday? Given last week’s empty shelves, I need a firm answer if possible. Also please confirm the total cost already committed and whether any earlier delivery slot is available. Dear Alan,

Thank you for your letter. Your account shows an order of 360 units for delivery on Monday 30 March, at a current price of $7.20 per unit. Your last delivery was ordered at 360 units and delivered at 360 units.

Total committed cost for this order: 360 x $7.20 = $2,592.00.

I can confirm the order is on your account for Monday 30 March. However, I am not able to give a firm guarantee of stock availability or the exact arrival time from the sales desk. Please contact our dispatch team directly to confirm stock status and whether an earlier delivery slot is possible, and they can give you a firm answer on the day.
